src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: Which city hosted the 2019 First Global DXB Challenge related to the fields of Robotics and Artificial Intelligence?
x: The first Global DXB Challenge (2019), on robotics and artificial intelligence, was held in Dubai, as its name (DXB = Dubai) suggests.

src: APPSC Civil Asst. Surgeon, Group-IV Services, District Proba
s: Which company joins Intel to launch AI skills lab in India in July 2023?
x: Dell Technologies joined Intel in July 2023 to launch an AI skills lab in India for students.

s: What is the name of the technology released in April 2023 by Russia's Sberbank to compete with ChatGPT in the artificial intelligence chatbot race?
x: Russia's Sberbank released GigaChat in April 2023 as its rival to ChatGPT.

s: In June 2023, which of the following companies signed a memorandum of understanding with Directorate General of Training to enable 6,000 students and 200 educators at Industrial Training Institutes and National Skills Training Institutions with AI and cloud skills?
x: In June 2023 Microsoft signed an MoU with the Directorate General of Training to give AI and cloud skills to 6,000 students and 200 educators of ITIs and NSTIs.

s: A multimodal AI tool that can respond in 11 Indian languages developed indigenously by BharatGPT ecosystem and Seetha Mahalakshmi Healthcare (SML) is:
x: Hanooman is the multimodal AI tool of the BharatGPT ecosystem and Seetha Mahalakshmi Healthcare, in 11 Indian languages. Krutrim is Ola's, OpenHathi is Sarvam AI's and Bhashini is MeitY's translation mission.

s: ChatGPT was developed by :
x: ChatGPT was developed by OpenAI and launched on 30 November 2022 on a large language model; Microsoft is an investor, not the developer.

s: What is the name of the Air India's a Generative AI virtual agent powered by Microsoft's Azure Open AI service?
x: Air India's generative-AI virtual agent on Microsoft's Azure OpenAI service is 'Maharaja' (2023). Vistara is an airline, Siri is Apple's assistant.

s: Which of the following is not an example of Virtual Assistant?
x: Alexa (Amazon), Cortana (Microsoft) and Siri (Apple) are virtual assistants; 'Cortesa' is not.

s: What is not true about India's first Artificial Intelligence-based job platform for persons with disabilities?
o: It is developed by IIT Hyderabad
It is funded by Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd.
There are 21 million persons with disabilities in the country.
x: Swarajability, India's first AI job platform for persons with disabilities, was built with IIT Hyderabad and funded by Kotak Mahindra Bank (a, b, c true). Printed key: the '21 million persons with disabilities' figure is the untrue one (Census 2011 counted about 2.68 crore).

s: Which of the following companies has launched Topaz, an AI-first set of services, solutions, and platforms using generative artificial intelligence technologies?
x: Topaz, an AI-first set of services, solutions and platforms using generative AI, was launched by Infosys (May 2023); Accenture, Wipro and IBM are distractors.

s: Which leading IT services company, has launched Topaz, a comprehensive suite of services, solutions, and platforms that harness the power of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies?
x: Topaz, the generative-AI suite of services, solutions and platforms, was launched by Infosys in May 2023; Wipro, TCS and HCL are distractors.

s: What is AIRAWAT?
o: India's AI based electronic vehicle motor car
India's AI based remote sensing camera
x: AIRAWAT is India's AI supercomputer / common AI compute platform (ranked 75th in Top500, 2023), not a car, camera or chatbot.

src: APPSC Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) General Studies & M
s: What is the name of an AI-first set of services, solutions, and platforms launched by Infosys to help amplify the potential of humans, enterprises and communities to tap into the next generation of opportunities to create value from unprecedented innovations, connected ecosystems and pervasive efficiencies?
x: Infosys launched Topaz (May 2023), an AI-first set of services, solutions and platforms built on generative AI.

src: APPSC Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) General Studies & M
s:
Which of these is/are correct about Jugalbandi, a multilingual AI-chat bot?

I. It was launched by Google in May 2023.

II. The chatbot has been developed by AI4 Bharat in collaboration with IIT Madras.

III. It will be accessible via popular messaging platform, WhatsApp.
x: Jugalbandi was launched by Microsoft (not Google) in May 2023 with AI4Bharat of IIT Madras and works through WhatsApp, so II and III are correct.

s: The ____ based in the cloud are bringing Artificial Intelligence to a far broader audience.
x: Cloud-based machine-learning tools (ML as a service) are bringing AI to a far broader audience, since users need no own hardware or expertise.

s: Data scientists require the following skills.
x: Data scientists need statistics, machine learning and data visualisation together, so 'all of the above'.

s: The branch of Artificial Intelligence is _____.
x: Machine learning is a branch (subset) of AI; network design, cyber forensics and full-stack development are not branches of AI.

s: FPGA are integrated circuits that are widely used to deploy AI. What is the full form of FPGA?
x: FPGA = Field Programmable Gate Array, an integrated circuit that can be reconfigured after manufacture, used to accelerate AI.

s:
Regarding Artificial Intelligence (AI), identify the correct statements using the codes given below :
A. Machine learning is a subset of AI.
B. Supervised learning involves training a computer system without labelled input data.
C. Machines learn through trial and error, receiving rewards during reinforcement learning.
Codes :
o: A, B and C all statements are correct
x: A is right: ML is a subset of AI. C is right: reinforcement learning is learning by trial and error with rewards. B is wrong: supervised learning uses labelled data.

s: Who among the following is known as Father of Artificial Intelligence?
x: John McCarthy, who coined the term 'artificial intelligence' for the 1956 Dartmouth workshop, is called the father of AI. Babbage is the father of the computer; Lee de Forest invented the triode; Eckert co-built ENIAC.

s: Artificial Intelligence means
x: AI is intelligence created in computers (machines) – machines copying human thinking functions; it is not 'artificial talents' or general creative reasoning.

s: Who is known as father of Artificial Intelligence?
x: John McCarthy coined 'artificial intelligence' (Dartmouth, 1956) and is called its father. Turing proposed the Turing test; Dartmouth is the workshop, not a person.

src: APPSC 2018 Lecturers in Government Polytechnic Colleges (Eng
s: Artificial Intelligence is augmenting the human capabilities by:
o: enhancing mechanical power of computing devices
helping the marketing activities throughout the globe
making machine intelligent and mimicking human actions
x: AI augments human capability by making machines intelligent and able to mimic human actions; more languages, mechanical power or marketing do not describe AI.

s:
With the present state of development, Artificial Intelligence can effectively do which of the following?
1. Bring down electricity consumption in industrial units
2. Create meaningful short stories and songs
3. Disease diagnosis
4. Text-to-Speech Conversion
5. Wireless transmission of electrical energy
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
x: AI can cut industrial electricity use (1), diagnose disease (3) and convert text to speech (4). Truly meaningful stories and songs (2) are still beyond it, and wireless power transmission (5) is physics, not AI.

src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer, Asst. Public Relation Off
s: India's first Autonomous Navigation facility, TiHAN inaugurated by the Union Minister of State for Science and Technology, Jitendra Singh at which IIT?
x: TiHAN, India's first testbed for autonomous navigation (drones and ground vehicles), was inaugurated at IIT Hyderabad in 2022.

src: AP recruitment paper (header page missing in scan)
s: Which of the following software companies is working with the farmers in Andhra Pradesh for yield management by using artificial intelligence (AI)?
x: Microsoft, with ICRISAT, gave AP farmers an AI sowing app (piloted in Kurnool, 2016) for yield-oriented advisories.

s:
Consider the following applications.

I. Facial recognition of criminals.

II. Hand writing comparison and recognition of the suicide notes in the criminal conspiracy cases.

III. Hacker who has cracked one's bank account password.

IV. Speech recognition as a password in the modern laptops.
Which of the applications given above is/are the exact application of artificial intelligence?
x: Facial recognition (computer vision), handwriting comparison and speech recognition are AI pattern-recognition applications (I, II, IV); a hacker cracking a password is a human act, not AI.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: The Telangana government will celebrate 2020 as the year of ____ to promote its use in various sectors such as agriculture, urban transportation and healthcare.
x: Telangana declared 2020 the 'Year of Artificial Intelligence' to promote AI in agriculture, transport and healthcare.

o: Responsible Artificial Intelligence for Social Environment
Responsible Artificial Intelligence for School Environment
Responsible Artificial Intelligence for Social Empowerment
Responsible Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Environment
x: RAISE = Responsible Artificial Intelligence for Social Empowerment, India's global AI summit of October 2020.

src: APPSC 2023 Screening test (Online Mode) to the post of Deput
s:
This question consist of two statements –
Assertion (A) and
Reason (R). Answer the question selecting the appropriate option given below:
Assertion (A): The department of science & technology and Telangana govt have partnered with T-Hub to establish MATH, an AI and ML hub.
Reason (R): MATH aims to support educational organizations and modernize higher education system.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
Both A and R are false.
x: MATH (Machine learning and AI Technology Hub) was set up by DST and the Telangana government with T-Hub, so A is true. Supporting educational organisations and modernising higher education is not its stated aim, so R is false.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: The Ministry of External Affairs, India is setting up a New, Emerging and Strategic Technologies (NEST) division. This will act as the nodal division within MEA for collaboration with foreign partners in the field of:
x: MEA's New, Emerging and Strategic Technologies (NEST) division (2020) is the nodal division for working with foreign partners on technologies such as 5G and artificial intelligence.

src: APPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer & Analyst Grade-II (A
s:
Which of the following statements regarding the Year-End Review 2024 of the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology is/are correct?
Statements:

1. The Government of India approved four semiconductor manufacturing units under the Semicon India Programme to enhance domestic chip production.

2. India hosted the 6th meeting of the GPAI Ministerial Council in New Delhi and was the outgoing chair of the Global Partnership on Artificial Intelligence (GPAI) in 2024.
x: Statement 1 is right: four semiconductor units were approved under the Semicon India Programme in 2024. Statement 2 is wrong: India hosted the 6th GPAI Ministerial Council (New Delhi, 3 July 2024) as the Lead Chair for 2024, not as the outgoing chair.

s: In which city was the AI Action Summit held in February 2025?
o: More than one of the above
x: The AI Action Summit of 10-11 February 2025 was held in Paris (Grand Palais), co-chaired by France and India.

s:
Consider the following statements regarding AI Action Summit held in Grand Palais, Paris in February 2025 :
I. Co-chaired with India, the event builds on the advances made at the Bletchley Park Summit held in 2023 and the Seoul Summit held in 2024.
II. Along with other countries, US and UK also signed the declaration on inclusive and sustainable AI.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: I is right: the India-co-chaired Paris summit built on Bletchley Park (2023) and Seoul (2024). II is wrong: the US and UK did not sign the declaration on inclusive and sustainable AI.

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-II Animal Husbandry Asst. 2
s: "The development of full Artificial Intelligence can spell the end of the human race." This is the opinion of
x: Stephen Hawking told the BBC (2014) that 'the development of full artificial intelligence could spell the end of the human race'.

s: Which of the following is not a source of Artificial Intelligence bias?
x: AI bias comes from data, algorithms and people (design and interpretation); 'ability' is not a source.

s: Which institution from below became the first to start Bachelor's Degree Course in Artificial Intelligence?
x: IIT Hyderabad became the first institution in India to offer a full B.Tech programme in AI (2019).

src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
s: As on March 2018, which of the following is the India's fastest supercomputer?
x: Pratyush (IITM Pune, unveiled January 2018, ~6.8 petaflops) was India's fastest supercomputer as of March 2018 (the question is dated; India's later AI system AIRAWAT ranked 75th in Top500 in 2023).

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
s: Which of the following is not an important application of quantum computing?
x: Quantum computing is applied to cryptography, drug discovery and financial modelling; desktop publishing needs no quantum computer.

src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: Which among the following consume least time to perform calculations?
x:
Official key / most books: Fugaku (fastest supercomputer). Strictly: Google's Sycamore did its quantum-supremacy task in about 200 seconds, a task claimed to take Summit 10,000 years (general knowledge, not checked).
Exam key: Fugaku (Japan) was the world's fastest supercomputer (2020-21), ahead of Summit and PARAM Siddhi. Sycamore is Google's quantum processor that did one special benchmark task very fast, not a general-purpose machine.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: ____ is the ability of a quantum system to be in multiple states at the same time until it is measured.
x: Superposition is the ability of a quantum system to be in several states at once until it is measured, when it collapses to one state.

s: Which one of the following is the context in which the term "qubit" is mentioned?
x: A qubit (quantum bit), the basic unit of quantum information, belongs to quantum computing; it can be 0 and 1 at once (superposition).

s: In August 2016, China developed a system nicknamed 'Micius' which is :
x: Micius (QUESS), launched by China on 16 August 2016, is the world's first quantum communication satellite, named after an ancient Chinese philosopher.

s: Which one of the following is the context in which the term 'qubit' is mentioned?
x: A qubit (quantum bit), the basic unit of quantum information, belongs to quantum computing; it can be 0 and 1 at once (superposition).

s: The United Nations has designated the year 2025 as the international year of which scientific field?
x: The UN declared 2025 the International Year of Quantum Science and Technology, marking 100 years of quantum mechanics.

s: India's first AI-powered anti-drone system named ______ was unveiled by the ______ firm, Grene Robotics in first week of September 2023.
x: Indrajaal, India's first AI-powered anti-drone system, was unveiled by Grene Robotics of Hyderabad in September 2023.

s: Project Vaani, to be implemented jointly by the Indian Institute of Sciences (IISc), ARTPARK (AI and Robotics Technology Park) and ____ will gather speech data from across India, for the creation of an AI-based language model that can understand diverse Indian languages and dialects
x: Project Vaani is run by IISc and ARTPARK with Google, collecting speech data from across India for AI language models.

s: Identify the company that launched 'Pratham' which is the world's first no-code computer vision platform :
x: Pratham, the world's first no-code computer-vision platform, was launched by Assert AI.

s: 'iOncology.ai', an Artificial Intelligence (AI) platform designed for the early detection of breast and ovarian cancer, was launched by :
o: All India Institute of Medical Sciences in collaboration with Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics (CAIR).
Dr. B. Borooah Cancer Institute in collaboration with Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB).
National Institute of Cancer Prevention and Research in collaboration with Artificial Intelligence Research Institute (AIRI).
All India Institute of Medical Sciences in collaboration with Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (CDAC).
x: iOncology.ai, for early detection of breast and ovarian cancer, was developed by AIIMS Delhi with C-DAC. CAIR (option a) is a DRDO lab and not the partner; the old notes record the APPSC 2024 key as (a) AIIMS–CAIR (official key not seen in this job).

s: ' Oncology.ai ', an Artificial Intelligence (AI) platform designed for the early detection of breast and ovarian cancer, was launched by:
o: All India Institute of Medical Sciences in collaboration with Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics (CAIR)
Dr. B. Borooah Cancer Institute in collaboration with Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB)
National Institute of Cancer Prevention and Research in collaboration with Artificial Intelligence Research Institute (AIRI)
All India Institute of Medical Sciences in collaboration with Centre for Development of Advanced Computing
x: iOncology.ai, for early detection of breast and ovarian cancer, was developed by AIIMS Delhi with C-DAC. CAIR (option a) is a DRDO lab and not the partner; the old notes record the APPSC 2024 key as (a) AIIMS–CAIR (official key not seen in this job).

s: Identify the company that launched ' Pratham Al ', which is the world's first no-code computer vision platform:
x: Pratham AI, the world's first no-code computer-vision platform, was launched by Assert AI; Microsoft, Google and Dell are distractors.

src: APPSC 2022 Various Non Gazetted Posts Limited Recruitment
s: India’s first AI-Powered Anti-Drone system named as ‘Indrajaal’ is launched in which city of India in September, 2023?
x: Indrajaal was developed by Grene Robotics of Hyderabad (September 2023).

s: Which of the following polymer is used in the manufacture of bulletproof material?
x: Kevlar, a strong aramid (para-aromatic polyamide) fibre, is used in bulletproof jackets and lightweight helmets; Nylon 6,6, rayon and Dacron are not used for this.

s: What is the 'fibre' used to make bulletproof jackets?
x: Kevlar, a strong aramid (para-aromatic polyamide) fibre, is used in bulletproof jackets and lightweight helmets; Nylon, Terylene and Tweed are not used for this.

s: Which one of the following polymer is used in making bullet-proof vests ?
x: Kevlar, the fibre of bullet-proof vests, is a para-aromatic polyamide, so 'polyamides' is right; Bakelite, Teflon and polyurethanes are not.

s: Light weight bullet proof helmets and jackets use which of the following fibres for their production?
x: Kevlar, a strong aramid (para-aromatic polyamide) fibre, is used in bulletproof jackets and lightweight helmets; Terylene and nylon are not used for this.

s: Which one of the following is called the 'metal of future'?
x: Titanium is called the 'metal of the future' – light, strong and corrosion-resistant, used in aerospace and surgical implants.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: In July 2019, 'Bhabha Kavach' was launched at the International Police Expo 2019 in New Delhi. Which of the following correctly describes this product?
o: Radiation protection suit worn by nuclear workers
Firefighter protective clothing also called as bunker gear
x: Bhabha Kavach, launched at the International Police Expo 2019 (New Delhi), is India's lightest bulletproof jacket, based on BARC technology.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test General Studies &
s: Which type of concrete paint among the following is used for areas with high chemical exposure?
x: Epoxy coatings resist chemicals and are used on concrete floors with high chemical exposure; acrylic latex paints are not chemical-resistant.

src: APPSC 2022 Various Non Gazetted Posts Limited Recruitment
s: Which of the following technologies is most closely associated with the term "artificial intelligence"?
x: Robotics is the technology most closely associated with artificial intelligence (exam key); biotechnology, nanotechnology and space exploration are separate fields.

s: The 'Imitation Game' was the original name of :
x: Alan Turing first called the Turing test 'the imitation game' (1950 paper Computing Machinery and Intelligence). LISP is a language; the Halting Problem is a different Turing result.

s:
Match List - I with List - II and choose the correct answer using the codes given below.
List - I (Emerging Technology):

a. Artificial Intelligence

b. Open-AI

c. Internet of Things IoT

d. Augmented reality
List - II (Scientist):

I. Kevin Ashton

II. Sam Altman

III. Thomas P. Caudell

IV. Alan Turing
x: AI – Alan Turing (IV), OpenAI – Sam Altman (II), IoT – Kevin Ashton (I), augmented reality – Thomas P. Caudell (III): a-IV, b-II, c-I, d-III.

s: Scientists from Hyderabad based institutions have successfully developed a 3D printed artificial Cornea. Name the institutions involved in developing it?
o: Institute of Molecular Biology, Shanta Biotech and LV Prasad Eye Hospital
LV Prasad Eye Institute, University of Hyderabad and Reddy's Laboratories
Max Vision Eye Hospital & Research Institute and University of Hyderabad
LV Prasad Eye Institute, IIT-Hyderabad and Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology
x: The 3D-printed artificial cornea was made by LV Prasad Eye Institute, IIT Hyderabad and CCMB, all of Hyderabad.

s: In India 3D-Printed Cornea and 3D-Printed Liver Tissue were developed respectively by:
o: L.V. Prasad Eye Institute and Pandorum Technologies
Aravind Eye Hospital and Strand Life Sciences
x: The 3D-printed cornea came from LV Prasad Eye Institute (with IIT Hyderabad and CCMB) and the 3D-printed human liver tissue from Pandorum Technologies, Bengaluru.

s: Which company launched a prototype humanoid robot in October 2022?
x: Tesla showed a prototype of its Optimus humanoid robot at its AI Day (30 Sept 2022), reported in October 2022.

s: What is the name of Indigenous Super Power Drone developed by Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur
x: IIT Kharagpur's 'Bhim' (2017), named after the Pandava Bhima, was called India's first indigenous 'superpower' drone; it can create a Wi-Fi zone of about 1 km in disaster areas.

s: What does acronym PaaS stand for in cloud computing ?
x: PaaS = Platform as a Service: a development platform with tools to build, test and deploy applications (e.g. Google App Engine).

s: Which of the following is not offered as an independent service layer in cloud computing?
x: The independent cloud layers are IaaS, PaaS and SaaS; 'hardware as a service' is not a separate layer (it falls under IaaS).

s: 'Sky Drive' is the name of Cloud Computing Service of which one of the following companies ?
x: SkyDrive (now OneDrive) is Microsoft's cloud storage service.

s: Cloud computing services does not include :
x: Cloud services are IaaS, PaaS and SaaS; allotting electromagnetic spectrum is a government (telecom) function, not a cloud service.

src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
s: Term used for large volume of high velocity, complex and variable data is:
x: Big data means very large volumes of high-velocity, complex and variable data (volume, velocity, variety).

src: APPSC Extension Officer Grade-I Common Paper (General Studie
s: One which is used for statistical computing
x: R is a programming language and environment for statistical computing and graphics.

src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: How can Artificial Intelligence (AI), Quantum Computing and Data Science together improve environmental monitoring and management?
o: By ignoring environmental data and focusing only on industrial profits
By analysing large datasets to predict pollution levels, optimize resource use and simulate complex climate models
By replacing traditional environmental policies with computer automation
By promoting random deforestation to test satellite imagery accuracy
x: Together, AI, quantum computing and data science analyse large datasets to predict pollution, optimise resource use and simulate climate models; the other options are absurd.

src: AP High Court Common Test for Multiple Posts 2026
s: Which private equity firm entered into a landmark joint venture with Tata Consultancy Services in 2025 to establish HyperVault AI Data Centre Ltd. for building AI-focused and sovereign data centres in India?
x: TCS and private-equity firm TPG formed HyperVault AI Data Centre Ltd (2025) to build AI-focused, sovereign data centres in India.

s: Money transactions with encryption techniques are used to transfer funds operating independently without a Central Bank intervention
x: Cryptocurrency uses encryption (cryptography) for peer-to-peer transfers without any central bank; RTGS and NEFT are RBI-run systems and legal tender is state money.

s:
With reference to 'Bitcoins', sometimes seen in the news, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. Bitcoins are tracked by the Central Banks of the countries.
2. Anyone with a Bitcoins address can send and receive Bitcoins from anyone else with a Bitcoins from anyone else with a Bitcoins address.
3. Online payments can be sent without either side knowing the identity of the other.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
x: Bitcoins are not tracked by central banks (1 wrong); anyone with a Bitcoin address can send and receive them (2) and payments can be made without either side knowing the other (3).

s: Which one of the following countries has officially recognised Bitcoin as a legal payment method since 1st April, 2017?
x: Japan recognised Bitcoin as a legal method of payment from 1 April 2017 (amended Payment Services Act); China and India did not.

s:
Which of the following statement(s) about Bitcoin is/are correct?

I. It is a decentralised virtual currency.

II. It is generated through complex computer software systems.

III. The Reserve Bank of India recognised it as a legal tender in January, 2016.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
x: Bitcoin is a decentralised virtual currency (I) created through computer mining (II); the RBI never recognised it as legal tender (III wrong).

src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer Screening Test General Stu
s: Who introduced the first Indian platform for Wholesale Cryptocurrency Trading?
x: BuyUcoin introduced the first Indian platform for wholesale (bulk, OTC) cryptocurrency trading in April 2019.

src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
s: One of the following is not a crypto currency:
x: The yen is Japan's sovereign (fiat) currency, not a cryptocurrency like Bitcoin or Ether.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
s: What is a Bit coin?
o: Copper coin used as currency for payments on dark web
A form of digital currency created and held electronically
x: Bitcoin is a decentralised digital (crypto) currency created and held electronically on a blockchain. Off-topic here; moved to blockchain and cryptocurrency.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: A __ is a time-stamped series of immutable records of data that is managed by a cluster of computers not owned by any single entity.
x: A blockchain is a time-stamped series of immutable records managed by a cluster of computers not owned by any single entity.

s:
With reference to " Blockchain Technology”, consider the following statements:
I. It is a public ledger that everyone can inspect, but no single user controls.
II. The structure and design of blockchain is such that all the data in it are about cryptocurrency only.
III. Applications that depend on basic features of blockchain can be developed without. anybody's permission.
Which of the statements given above is / are correct?
x: I is right: a public ledger anyone can inspect but no single user controls. III is right: blockchain apps can be built without permission. II is wrong: blockchain holds land records, certificates, supply chains and more, not only cryptocurrency.

s:
Consider the following statements in respect of the digital rupee:
1. It is a sovereign currency issued by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) in alignment with its monetary policy.
2. It appears as a liability on the RBI's balance sheet.
3. It is insured against inflation by its very design.
4. It is freely convertible against commercial bank money and cash.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: The e-rupee is sovereign currency issued by the RBI (1), a liability on the RBI's balance sheet (2) and freely convertible against bank money and cash (4); nothing in its design insures it against inflation (3).

src: APPSC AE (Subordinate Services) Mains General Studies & Ment
s: General sunscreen lotions provide protection from these rays?
x: Sunscreen lotions absorb or reflect ultraviolet rays, which cause sunburn and skin cancer.

src: APPSC Animal Husbandry Department General Studies & Mental A
s: The semen straws are sterilised by
x: Semen straws are sterilised by exposing them to UV rays (UV lamps kill bacteria and viruses); autoclaving or hot air would damage the plastic straws.

s: What is 'sonic boom' related to?
x: A sonic boom is the shock-wave bang produced by an object moving faster than sound, such as a supersonic aircraft; lasers, radar and reflection are unrelated.

s: ' Sonic boom ' is related to
x: A sonic boom is the loud shock-wave sound produced by an aircraft travelling faster than sound (supersonic aircraft).

s: The substance used for the treatment of muscular pains and paralysis is
x: Infra-red rays produce heat that relaxes muscles and improves blood flow, so they are used in physiotherapy for muscular pain and paralysis.

s: Which one of the following types of waves are used in a night vision apparatus?
x: Night-vision devices detect the infra-red (thermal) radiation emitted by objects; radio waves and microwaves are for communication and radar.

s: Which one among the following has the highest energy?
x: Photon energy rises with frequency; among blue, green, yellow and red, blue has the shortest wavelength and so the highest energy.

s: A worker was working on the rail track. A boy at a distance holds his ear near the rail track. This boy was able to hear sound of the blow of workman twice. It is because of :
o: The speed of sound is greater in steel than in air
The speed of sound is greater in air than in steel
Part of the sound wave is reflected between the rail
His ears are at different distance from the source
x: Sound travels much faster in steel (~5,000-6,000 m/s) than in air (~343 m/s), so the boy hears the blow first through the rail and then through the air.

s: Which one is not an example of electromagnetic wave?
x: Gamma rays, X-rays and UV are electromagnetic waves; 'supersonic' describes speeds above the speed of sound, so supersonic (sound) waves are not electromagnetic.

s: Which of the following has the longest wavelength ?
x: Radio waves have the longest wavelength (over 1 m) of the EM spectrum, longer than infrared, visible light and X-rays.

s: Which of the following electromagnetic radiations has the maximum energy?
x: Energy rises from infrared to visible to UV to X-rays (and gamma), so X-rays have the most energy among the options.

s: Which of the following radiations has the highest energy per quantum?
x: Photon energy is inversely proportional to wavelength, so the shortest band, 200-280 nm (UV-C), has the highest energy per quantum.

s: The visible range of solar radiation is –
x: Visible light lies between about 400 and 700 nm, with UV below 400 nm and infrared above 700 nm.

s: Waves used for telecommunication are –
x: Microwaves (300 MHz-300 GHz) carry point-to-point telecom links, terrestrial relays and satellite communication.

s: What is the distance between two successive crests or successive troughs called?

s: Kiya.ai, a digital solutions provider serving financial institutions and governments globally, announced the launch of India's first-ever banking metaverse in June 2022. What is the name of this banking metaverse?
x: Kiya.ai launched 'Kiyaverse' in June 2022, billed as India's first banking metaverse.

s: What is Metaverse?
x: The metaverse is a shared virtual world where people interact through avatars using AR/VR; it is not just a video game.

s:
Recently, NITI Aayog approved a proposal to conduct a study on the use of facial recognition technology in India. In the context of facial recognition technology, consider the following statements:

I. A National Automated Facial Recognition System (NAFRS) is being developed by the National Informatics Centre, under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

II. The biggest demerit of facial recognition technology is its limitation in identifying people in real-time and not in photos and videos.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: NAFRS is being developed by the NCRB (MHA), not NIC, so I is wrong. The main concerns about facial recognition are privacy, accuracy and bias, not an inability to work in real time, so II is wrong too.

s: Which one of the following words/phrases is most appropriately used to denote "an interoperable network of 3D virtual worlds that can be accessed simultaneously by millions of users, who can exert property rights over virtual items"?
x: 'An interoperable network of 3D virtual worlds accessed simultaneously by millions, with property rights over virtual items' defines the metaverse (UPSC 2024).

s: Which Department in India has developed the Artificial Intelligence-based facial recognition tool named 'ASTR'?
x: ASTR (AI and Facial Recognition powered Solution for Telecom SIM Subscriber Verification) was developed by the Department of Telecommunications to weed out SIMs taken on fake documents.

src: APPSC AEE (Civil), AMVI, Agriculture Officer and Other Posts
s: Who invented geofencing?
x: Geofencing (a virtual boundary that triggers an action on a device) is credited to Michael Dimino, who patented it in the 1990s; Getting, Gladys West and Easton are GPS pioneers.

s: What is trade point ?
o: A forum of Indian financial institutions
x: A Trade Point is a node of UNCTAD's world-wide electronic trade information network (Global Trade Point Network), not a stock market or financial forum.

s: What is trade point ?
o: A forum of Indian financial institutions
x: A Trade Point is part of a world-wide electronic trade data network (UNCTAD Trade Point Programme / World Trade Point Federation).

s: Technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning, blockchain, IoT, geo-spatial mapping are powering the ______.
x: AI, machine learning, blockchain, IoT and geo-spatial mapping are technologies of the fourth industrial revolution; the third was electronics and IT.

s:
With reference to 'Software as a Service (SaaS)', consider the following statements:

A. SaaS buyers can customise the user interface and can change data fields.

B. SaaS users can access their data through their mobile devices.

C. Outlook, Hotmail and Yahoo! Mail are forms of SaaS.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: SaaS users can customise the interface and data fields, access data from mobile devices, and web mail such as Outlook, Hotmail and Yahoo! Mail is SaaS, so all three (UPSC 2022).

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-II(B) VRO/Village Surveyor
s: The 'Cloud Computing' technology refers to
o: A set of algorithms that solves problems using fuzzy logic
Many computers that are inter connected through wireless networks and satellites
A system of storing and accessing data and programs over the internet instead of storing on the computers hard drive
A futuristic technology that will use clouds to perform computing
x: Cloud computing means storing and accessing data and programs over the internet instead of on the computer's hard drive.
